subject: Subprocessor scoping & KMS access — Catalyst Cloud onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Dana Reeves <dana@catalystcloud.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Catalyst Cloud Security Team <security@catalystcloud.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Onboarding: subprocessor inventory + KMS access evidence request

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for coordinating with us on the integration. As part of our security intake for new service integrations we need the following to complete our third-party risk assessment:

- Current list of subprocessors (hosts, monitoring, logging, analytics) with roles/regions and whether they process customer data.
- KMS/key management evidence: architecture diagram showing where keys are generated/managed, key rotation policy excerpt, and confirmation whether you allow any customer-provided keys or cross-tenant key access.
- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted is fine) plus last external penetration test summary or link.
- Dataflow mapping showing egress to third-parties and retention controls.

Can you provide these items as a single package or share a secure link? We are trying to complete the intake by Dec 20 to keep our internal launch schedule. If any of these require an exception or additional discussion (e.g., KMS policies), please flag that and we can schedule a short call.

Thanks,
Dana Reeves
Head of Vendor Security, Catalyst Cloud
[dana@catalystcloud.com]

[Attachment: Catalyst_Onboard_Questionnaire_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dana Reeves <dana@catalystcloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding: subprocessor inventory + KMS access evidence request

Hi Dana —

Appreciate the checklist. We can absolutely provide a scoped package. Proposed plan and timeline:

1) By EOD Mon 2026-12-13: preliminary subprocessor inventory CSV, SOC 2 Type II (redacted) and a high-level KMS architecture diagram.
2) By Thu 2026-12-16: supplemental dataflow mapping and key policy excerpts (rotation, revocation).
3) If you need deeper provenance (e.g., HSM attestation or Customer-managed KMS options), we should schedule a short call to confirm scope — propose 30 minutes Dec 18.

Notes / constraints up-front:
- We do not provide raw key material or private key access to third parties. We can provide key policy artifacts and an architecture diagram showing HSM/KMS boundaries and key lifecycle.
- SOC 2 report will be redacted for customer data and internal vendor names where required.

I'll assemble the package and send a secure Drive link. Looping in our security and compliance owners on this thread.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference
sofia@redwoodinference.com

[Planned attachments: subproc_inventory_202612.csv (stub), kms_keyflow_diagram.png (stub), soc2_type2_redacted.pdf (stub)]

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Catalyst Cloud onboarding - need KMS provenance + subproc confirmation

Team — quick sync on Catalyst Cloud (vendor onboarding request). They asked for: subprocessor inventory, KMS/key management evidence, SOC 2, and dataflow mapping. Details below — can you confirm availability and what we can share?

Requests and asks:
- Marissa: can you generate the latest subprocessor CSV (include provider role, region, data processed flag, contract renewal months)? We need that by Mon EOD 12/13.
- Karthik: we need a concise KMS architecture diagram (HSM boundary, key custody, KMS provider, rotation cadence) and a short policy excerpt (rotation frequency, dual control if applicable). Do not include private key material. Can you advise whether we can provide attestation of HSM tamper-evidence?
- Laura: please pull the redacted SOC 2 Type II PDF and any relevant pen test executive summary we can share.

Proposed transfer mechanism: Google Drive secure folder with view-only and time-limited link; for any artifact that contains customer identifiers we will deliver via SFTP to their security mailbox.

If any of this requires legal/security approval to redact more aggressively, flag here.

Thanks — Sofia

[This is internal; no external recipients on this message]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Dec 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal: Catalyst Cloud onboarding - need KMS provenance + subproc confirmation

Sofia — sending what I have assembled. Attached: subproc_inventory_202612.csv (export), soc2_type2_redacted.pdf (redacted), kms_keyflow_diagram.png (diagram). Notes:

- Subproc list: includes hosts (GCP us-west1), monitoring (Datadog), analytics (Snowflake for aggregated telemetry), logging (ELK cluster managed by vendor X). Column "processes_customer_data" flagged true for logging and analytics.
- SOC2: redacted auditor name and customer examples out of caution. Executive summary included.
- KMS: we do not allow external key import. Keys are generated in an HSM-backed KMS (CloudKMS with HSM tier), rotation frequency is 90 days for data keys; master keys rotated under dual-operator workflow semi-annually. No cross-tenant key access.
- Pen test: we have a summary from 2026-07; I included the three high-level remediation items.

I'll upload the artifacts to the secure Drive folder once Sofia confirms the delivery mechanism.

-Marissa
Director, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Onboarding: subprocessor inventory + KMS access evidence request

Hi Dana —

Thanks for your patience. Attached and linked below is the onboarding package we discussed. We have redacted items to protect other customers and internal vendor contract terms where appropriate; if you need additional detail we can consider an NDA/procurement route.

Package contents (delivered):
- subproc_inventory_202612.csv — role, region, processes_customer_data flag (attached)
- kms_keyflow_diagram.png — HSM/KMS boundary and key custody flow (attached)
- soc2_type2_redacted.pdf — our latest Type II report (attached)
- dataflow_mapping_v2.drawio — high-level dataflow to third parties (Drive link)
- pen_test_summary_202607.pdf — executive summary (Drive link)

Delivery and access:
- Secure Drive folder (view-only, link expires 30 days): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C4CatalystOnboard
- For any file that contains customer identifiers we will provide a time-limited SFTP transfer to security@catalystcloud.com upon request.

KMS clarifications:
- We do not permit external party key import or cross-tenant key access. Keys are HSM-backed (CloudKMS HSM tier). Data keys rotate every 90 days; master keys rotated under a dual-operator workflow semi-annually. We can provide a signed attestation for HSM deployment and key policy excerpts under an NDA.

Next steps:
- Please confirm if the Drive package satisfies your intake by Dec 20.
- If you need an attestation or additional provenance, can we schedule a 30-minute call on Fri Dec 18? I'm available 09:00-11:00 PT.

Best regards,
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference
sofia@redwoodinference.com
